critical: ch15-s08 / ch03-s01 suspects: the frame promises a verdict on three suspects pinned in ch01-s05 (RULES, KNOWLEDGE, LEARNING), but the narration never charges or clears any of them. RULES is never named again, KNOWLEDGE only once ('the rival suspect', L0513), and LEARNING's dark lantern is never lit. The final answer, 'Never one person. The board was a network all along.' (L1514), is abstract and leaves the detective plot without its verdict. Fix: give the verdict before L1514, e.g. 'Rules alone could not do it. Knowledge, typed in by hand, could not do it. Learning did, with its accomplices: data, fire, a messenger running backward, and people choosing.' Then tag the suspects as they appear: L0215 '...and Minsky turned to symbols and rules. Our first suspect.'

ch10-s06 L1013–L1014: the transformer deep dive (a required in-depth topic) never says out loud the step that makes attention work. The third card, the message (V), is introduced in L1010 and then never used in the narration. The visual pours the messages into 'bank', but the ear goes straight from 'About half runs to river' to 'So bank means the water's edge'. Fix L1014: 'Each cup carries its word's message into bank, mostly river's. So bank now means the water's edge.'

ch15-s05 L1508: an 8-card montage covers every lab in 2026: Glasswing, the Pentagon dispute and the court split, the $1.5B copyright settlement, OpenAI's 'warning shot', the Hugging Face sceptic, both Amodei quotes and the voluntary accord. It plays under a single 5-word line, with each card up for about one second. No viewer can read it, so the film's 'current understanding' and its even-handed treatment of labs, Anthropic included, are effectively not there. Fix: narrate 3 lines across 3 lamps that name the lab each time (for example the Anthropic–Pentagon split court rulings, OpenAI's own 'warning shot' and the sceptic's reply, and Amodei's 'slow the pace' next to his own 'unlikely to happen'). Move the rest to fewer cards with longer holds (3 s or more each), or cut them.

Metaphor collision on 'curtain': L1032–L1033 define the curtain as the causal mask ('The curtain hides the words to come'). L1503 then reuses it for hidden chain-of-thought ('think longer, behind a curtain'). Viewers who have just learned what the curtain means will map it to the wrong mechanism. Fix L1503: 'Then the machines learned to think longer, on scratch paper we are not shown.' Give the ch15-s02 visual its own image too, e.g. a folded draft or a shuttered window, not the decoder's curtain.

Orphaned visual cues (the shots stage will break): ch15-s08's climactic pull-back is anchored 'On 'Step back'', and ch10-s03 is anchored on 'drop the reading in order'. Neither phrase appears in any line after the voice pass. Fix: re-anchor to words that exist (ch15-s08: 'clue' in L1513; ch10-s03: 'attention' in L1006), or restore the phrase in a line.

issues.problem: 'One small candle goes out. The big one is trimmed.' The ear never hears what the small candle believed: 'grow the model faster than the data' is only on screen. The line is a riddle with no answer.
issues.fix: L1115–L1116: 'In 2022, a smaller model, Chinchilla, read far more on the same budget, and won. The belief that you should grow the model faster than its reading lasted two years. The big candle, scale, is merely trimmed.'

issues.problem: The candle's belief is voiced only halfway ('compute is the chokepoint'). The part it needs later, 'China is one to three years behind', is on screen only, so L1410 and the payoff 'the gap is months' (L1417) don't land for a listener.
issues.fix: 'A new candle: compute is the chokepoint, and China is a year or three behind.'

issues.problem: The second AI winter, a must-cover topic, gets 2 lines with a broken antecedent: 'its special machines' could mean the panel's or the winter's. A listener cannot tell what went dark or why.
issues.fix: 'In 1984, at a meeting in Austin, a panel warned of what some called an AI winter. By 1987 the companies selling special machines for this kind of AI were going dark. The knowledge candle burned about seven years.'

issues.problem: The 1988 Fodor–Pylyshyn systematicity critique is one of the film's best live debates (Lake & Baroni 2023 says the challenge persists), but it appears on screen only. The brief asks for 'the debates' and 'who dissented', and the narration skips this one.
issues.fix: Add before L0519: 'Two philosophers objected: anyone who can say John loves the girl can say the girl loves John. Can a net promise that? The argument still runs.' (quote q fodor-pylyshyn is on screen already).

issues.problem: Good plant: 'the most important clue in this case sat in a thesis about rounding errors.' The payoff is never voiced. L0511 says 'Several people, separately' without turning back to Helsinki, so the film's best mystery hook pays off only in on-screen text.
issues.fix: L0511: 'Who invented it? Several people, separately. Remember Helsinki? The rounding-error thesis held the same trick, run backward. The 1986 paper made it stick.'

issues.problem: 'until the hidden lanterns notice what nobody pointed out' is lovely but abstract. The concrete wonder, family trees with hidden units encoding nationality and generation unasked, is on screen only, and it is the emotional seed of the film's 'nobody told it' refrain.
issues.fix: Add: 'Shown family trees, its hidden lanterns sorted people by nationality and by generation. Nobody asked them to.'

issues.problem: The Lee Sedol match, the most human-emotional public moment in the story, gets 3 rushed lines. The bible's editorial note says to 'give him move 78 and his own words', but no Lee Sedol quote is used.
issues.fix: Add q-lee-entity to the OST or the narration: after L0907, 'Three years later he retired. "Even if I become the number one," he said, "there is an entity that cannot be defeated."' Offset the words with the trims below.

issues.problem: 'By 2022, the choosing had shears.' This is opaque to the ear: the hedge and topiary that make the shears meaningful are only on screen.
issues.fix: 'By 2022, the choosing had shears, and the model was a hedge to be shaped.'

issues.problem: 'Our first note still holds.' The listener has to recall which note. The payoff for L0107–L0109 is strong but undersold.
issues.fix: 'Our first note in the file still holds: it sometimes sounds right, and is wrong.'

issues.problem: 'The three lanterns from the winters? Two in the light. One at its edge.' A listener can't decode which is which, and L1509–L1510 make the same point clearly two chapters later.
issues.fix: Cut L1312 (saves 13 words), or make it plain: 'And the three who kept nets alive through the winters now stood at different lamps.'

issues.problem: 'Five hundred million dollars came from FTX. Anthropic was not implicated in FTX's fraud.' FTX arrives with no context, so to the ear it is a non sequitur, and the disclaimer draws attention without informing.
issues.fix: 'Much of its early money came from a crypto exchange, FTX, which later collapsed in fraud. Anthropic was not implicated.'

issues.problem: 'Three months before Florence.' Florence has not yet been mentioned in the narration, so this reads as a slip, not a hook.
issues.fix: Make it a deliberate tease: 'Three months later, in Florence, the floor would give way.'

issues.problem: 'In fairness, the blame was shared.' Shared by whom? The even-handed point is lost to the ear.
issues.fix: 'In fairness, the Navy, the papers and Rosenblatt himself all fed the hype. He later called the reporters a pack of happy bloodhounds.' (e2-hype-responsibility)

issues.problem: 'a figure called back-propagating error-correction': 'figure' sounds like a person or a diagram.
issues.fix: 'In it, a procedure he called back-propagating error-correction. A false clue: same name, different trick.'

issues.problem: 'It burned sixteen years.' 'It' refers to the candle lit nine lines earlier. Over 30 minutes the candle refrain should name its belief, or the device turns into numbers without referents.
issues.fix: 'The logic-machine candle burned sixteen years.' / 'The learning-machine candle burned about seven years.'

issues.problem: Double simile ('a barcode of waves, like a clock's hands'). Two images in one breath, in a chapter that already carries cards, jug, cups, scribe, highlighter, loom, lane and curtain.
issues.fix: 'All at once loses the order. So each word wears a little clock face, its hands set by its place in line.'

issues.problem: 'And a straight lane carries each word through.' A residual connection, unexplained, as one more metaphor in an overloaded chapter.
issues.fix: Cut (saves 8 words) and leave the lane visual-only, or say 'and each word keeps a copy of itself as it goes'.

issues.problem: Ch14 is the flattest chapter for the ear: three unconnected briefing facts in a row (open weights, talent, distillation allegation), with no human voice from the Chinese side. Amodei is quoted in the narration; Liang Wenfeng's on-screen quote is not.
issues.fix: Voice Liang in ch14-s02 for balance and humanity: 'DeepSeek's founder put it simply: "Money has never been the problem for us; bans on shipments of advanced chips are the problem."' Compress L1412–L1414 into two lines.

issues.problem: The register is almost entirely clipped fragments and aphorisms ('Two tricks.' 'A cliff.' 'Records.'). The aphorisms are often superb, but across 32 minutes the staccato reads like captions, not a warm, unhurried old teacher. Fewer than 1 line in 20 is a full, rolling sentence with a subordinate clause, and the narrator almost never shows delight ('I love this part', 'Now, here is the lovely thing').
issues.fix: At each chapter opening and each emotional beat (ch04-s04, ch06-s01, ch08-s06, ch10-s04, ch13-s01), let one line run long and musical, in the teacher's own pleasure, e.g. ch08-s06: 'Nobody cut these stencils. They began as noise, as snow on a television, and the messenger from 1986 cut them, one patient nudge at a time.'

issues.problem: The silent pinning of Hinton's 'graduate student' slip is a beautiful plant, but in a dense film a silent card may not register as something to remember.
issues.fix: Keep the silence, but extend minDuration to 11 s or more so the slip can be read twice, and have the music state the motif clearly (as planned) so the ch15-s09 return is recognised.

issues.problem: Fairness and stakes: the narration names only Hinton and Bengio as signatories. The claim (e12-cais) notes that Hassabis, Altman and Dario Amodei also signed, which matters for the even-handed picture of labs warning about their own products.
issues.fix: Add 6 words: 'His name came first. Yoshua Bengio's, second. Lab heads signed too.' Name them on screen.

issues.problem: 3,227 narration words against a 3,040 target (+6%). The estimated runtime with minDuration floors is about 34.5 min at 135 wpm and about 37 min at 120 wpm, at or above the brief's 30–35 min range. The fixes above add about 90 words.
issues.fix: Offset by cutting about 250 words: L1312 (13), L1022 (8), L0210's Gerard clause to on-screen only (~12), ch05-s08 Fifth Generation on screen only, ch12-s08 L1218 to 'Then, a stampede.' (~18), ch14-s06 compressed (~15), ch11-s04 L1108–L1109 merged (~8), and trim L0815 and L0823 phrasing. Re-check that silent-shot minDuration floors are not inflating the runtime.

issues.problem: L0202–L0205 are in the historic present ('finds', 'describe'), then L0206 onward switches to the past. The shift is audible in a slow read.
issues.fix: Keep the historic present for scene openings throughout, or put L0202–L0205 in the past ('found a home', 'described'). Be consistent per scene.

issues.problem: 'worked by a bomber's autopilot' is vague and odd to the ear.
issues.fix: '...a learning machine, its knobs turned by a surplus bomber's autopilot.' (e1-snarc)

strengths: An outstanding plant-and-payoff lattice. Widrow's 'Remember him' pays off in ch03 and in 'He never did get over it' (L1511). Hopfield's 'Remember it for him' pays off in 'The talk nobody remembered, remembered.' The bet ('Who paid for dinner?') resolves in ch07-s01. 'Pre-training... a different coat' returns in L1101. Florence's 'simply by waiting' becomes 'They only had to wait.' Cyc 1985 sits against GPT-2's next word, and Rosenblatt 1961 is called 'Sixty-one years early.' The Buffalo mail connects 1958, 1989 and 2012. 'Why would anyone choose the fog?' is answered in L0826.

The candle-clock device (beliefs burning exactly as long as they were held, doubters at the rim) works as both a structure and a teaching tool. 'It burned twenty years. The new way spread within two.' and 'A struck match. Out within a day.' are memorable.

Hinton as an unnamed 'tall man at the edge of the light' (L0415–L0416), named only in ch05, then standing at a wastebasket, taking down his own forecast slip (L1302 'It is his own.'), and walking back to the rim: 'Persistence is not the same as certainty.' A real emotional throughline that never puts words in his mouth.

Aphorisms that will be quoted: 'A winter, then, of prestige, not of use.' 'It was not a new engine. It was a new door.' 'One program out-prescribed Stanford specialists, and never treated a patient.' 'Not every clue is part of the suspect... The lesson is.'

The 'nobody told it' refrain builds the film's central wonder across 80 years: nobody wrote it a rulebook, nobody pointed out the hidden features, nobody cut these stencils, nobody told the towers to divide the work, nobody told it to plan.

The deep dives open with honest promises ('you could explain this machine to a friend'; 'three cards, one jug, and why we divide by eight') and keep them with worked numbers on tactile objects: the pierced tin lantern, the jug of light, the divide-by-eight payoff.

Restraint at the deaths. Pitts, McCulloch and Rosenblatt are handled with one plain line each and long silent holds. The silent 'In memory of Frank Rosenblatt' dedication in ch04-s05 is the film's most moving image.

The cold open and its return work as bookends: the dark room in ch01, the same composition in ch12-s06 with the first harmony on 'new door', and the struck match in the viewer's own hand at the end ('Perhaps it's you'). Together they make an earned call to curiosity.

Fair-minded caveats are built into the voice, not bolted on: 'accounts differ', 'seven networks voting', 'Once you'd ruled out king itself', 'She says she was fired; Google says she resigned', 'nobody knows exactly who is ahead'.
